definitions.gloss: honest; upright; incorruptible; clean and principled
definitions.explanation: Describes a person of integrity who is free from corruption, dishonesty, or self-serving behavior. Often used to describe politicians, officials, or leaders who are morally upright.

examples.japanese: {清廉|せいれん}な{政治家|せいじか}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: He is known as an incorruptible politician.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{清廉|せいれん}な{人柄|ひとがら}は{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}に{尊敬|そんけい}されている。
examples.english: His honest character is respected by many people.

examples.japanese: {清廉潔白|せいれんけっぱく}であることが、リーダーには{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: Leaders are expected to be completely honest and above reproach.

notes:
A な-adjective composed of {清|せい} (pure, clean) + {廉|れん} (honest, upright). A literary, formal word used primarily in discussing public figures and moral character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {清廉|せいれん}な{政治家|せいじか}: an incorruptible politician
- {清廉|せいれん}な{人柄|ひとがら}: an honest character
- {清廉潔白|せいれんけっぱく}: spotlessly clean, above reproach (four-character compound)
- {清廉|せいれん}さ: integrity, incorruptibility

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誠実|せいじつ}: sincere, honest — broader meaning, used in personal relationships too
- {高潔|こうけつ}: noble, high-minded — emphasizes moral elevation
- {廉潔|れんけつ}: upright, integrity — very similar, slightly more literary
